---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Documentation instructions

- Keep documentation accurate to the code and clearly distinguish demo behavior from production guarantees.
- Prefer concise headings, short paragraphs, and runnable commands that do not contain real credentials.
- Document configuration variables, defaults, and whether they are required.
- Do not include secrets, personal information, or unsupported claims.
- Update relevant documentation when changing public behavior or configuration.
